summary: Frontend-only testing of ClientVerse Role & Permission Enforcement phase. 10 of 11 flows PASS. One CRITICAL frontend bug: admin webhook Verify button throws 'openVerify is not defined' ReferenceError, blocking the secret reveal flow (a stated acceptance criterion). All member restrictions, admin gating, invite creation/resend/revoke, invite lookup edge states (bad token, wrong account), and full register+accept-invite flow work correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: onClick handler calls openVerify(wh) but the function `openVerify` is never defined anywhere in the file. Clicking any admin `webhook-verify-<id>` button triggers a React runtime error overlay: `ReferenceError: openVerify is not defined`. The Verify dialog never opens, so the signing secret cannot be revealed via the UI. Needed behavior (per spec): fetch GET /api/webhooks/{id}/secret and call setVerify({...wh, secret: data.secret}).

issues: Console warning: DialogContent missing Description / aria-describedby (accessibility, non-blocking)

action_items: CRITICAL: Define the missing `openVerify` function in /app/frontend/src/components/WebhookManager.jsx. It must fetch `GET /api/webhooks/{id}/secret` and setVerify({ ...wh, secret: data.secret }) so the Verify dialog + webhook-secret-value input render for admins. This is an explicit acceptance criterion.
Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to the invite dialog to remove accessibility console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: WebhookManager.jsx: `openVerify` referenced on line 127 but never declared -- causes runtime crash when admin clicks Verify. This is a hard functional break of a documented admin governance feature.

Role/permission gating in AppShell, Team, AcceptInvite, WorkspaceDetail (approvals) is implemented correctly and does not rely on hidden UI (server 403s produce the forbidden panel and members are gated by user.role checks with awaiting-admin badges).
AcceptInvite handles all 4 states (pending, expired, revoked, accepted) plus wrong-account and bad-token error states properly; token is read from ?token= query string.
Login supports ?redirect= param used by AcceptInvite's `Sign in to accept` handoff.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Only the `openVerify` missing-function bug remains. After main agent adds the function fetching /api/webhooks/{id}/secret and setting verify state, retest: (1) click webhook-verify-<id> as admin -> webhook-verify-dialog + webhook-secret-value populated, (2) click webhook-rotate-<id>, reopen Verify, confirm new secret != old. All other role/permission flows are already validated end-to-end at the UI layer and do not need re-testing unless main agent changes gating logic.
rca of the issue: In /app/frontend/src/components/WebhookManager.jsx, line 127 attaches onClick={() => openVerify(wh)} to the admin-only Verify button, but the function is never declared in the component. `rotate`, `test`, `toggle`, `create`, `replay`, `copy` are all declared, but `openVerify` was omitted. Repro: login as admin -> Registries -> Webhooks tab -> click Verify on any endpoint -> React error overlay 'ReferenceError: openVerify is not defined'. Fix: add `const openVerify = async (wh) => { const { data } = await api.get(`/webhooks/${wh.id}/secret`); setVerify({ ...wh, secret: data.secret }); };` (or equivalent shape depending on backend response).
